title: Clearer product action button
summary: Replace the pale product action with a dark green, high-contrast action and a circular arrow icon.

changes.detail: Increase action height to 46px and label size to 12px, use white text on dark green, replace diagonal text arrow with a consistent SVG arrow in a circular background, and add pointer-hover and keyboard-focus feedback. Existing reduced-motion support is retained.
